Question: If namaz is performed behind emmam and after emmam completes the prayer ,and any body praying behind him who reached late and got only 1 rakat then he will complete the rakats left ,in this left rakats if he does mistake, does he need to do sizda sahoo? Answer ID: 1462 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 854/854=J) Yes, If masbooq (one who misses some rakats of salah with imam) commits any mistake that requires Sajdah Sahv then he has to do Sajdah Sahv . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
